title: Compact table row collapse and touch affordance issues in Safari/Firefox mobile
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary: Several reports from QA and customer sessions show the compact table variant exhibits inconsistent row collapse behavior and tiny touch hit areas on Safari (iOS) and Firefox (Android) when density toggles and virtualized rendering are enabled. This ticket triages the observed issues, captures repro steps, proposes fixes, and coordinates a small design+eng patch release.

Background: The compact table supports: density toggles (compact/comfortable), row-expansion (collapsible rows for metadata), virtualized rendering for large datasets, and sticky column headers. To save layout passes we relied on transform: translateY for virtualization and CSS clip/overflow to hide collapsed content. On mobile browsers we see: 1) collapsed rows still react to taps (ghost hitboxes), 2) collapse animation stutters or jumps when header is sticky, 3) checkbox tap targets inside compact rows are <44px in some zoom/scale combos, 4) Firefox mobile shows clip/overflow differences leading to visually clipped content during expand.

Scope: Repros across internal QA devices, fix CSS heuristics or small JS fallback for specific engines, add regression tests and a focused design token patch for touch targets. We will not change virtualization library wholesale in this ticket; if deeper changes are needed we will create a follow-up.

Acceptance criteria:
- Collapsed rows are inert to pointer events (no ghost taps) across Safari iOS 16+ and Firefox Android latest.
- Row expand/collapse animations do not jump when header is sticky; performance is stable at 60fps on measured devices (profile: mid-tier Android and iPhone SE gen 2).
- All interactive elements in compact density meet minimum 44px touch target or have explicit hit-area overlays documented and accessible.
- QA checklist with device matrix and repro steps added to ticket; at least 3 QA passes confirmed and signoff by Design and Eng.

Proposed fixes / tradeoffs:
- Replace overflow: hidden + transform stacking that hides elements with conditional pointer-events: none when an element is collapsed to prevent ghost taps (low-risk change).
- For virtualization, fall back to top/left positioning for collapsed items on Safari iOS when the sticky header is present (adds one extra layout pass only on affected UA).
- Add an invisible 8px padding hitbox around inline controls (checkboxes, row menu) controlled by a design token so it can be toggled per density. This increases touch area without altering visual density.
- Add a small CSS feature-detection shim for -webkit-overflow-scrolling differences to avoid clip anomalies in Firefox.

Risks and decisions:
- Using pointer-events toggles hides elements from screen readers if not careful. Decision: only set pointer-events:none on the collapsed container itself; keep interactive controls removed from DOM (aria-hidden) when collapsed for screen-reader consistency. Engineering to confirm DOM order changes acceptable.
- The virtualization fallback may increase paint cost on affected UAs; we restrict the fallback to user-agents detected by our runtime UA whitelist to limit regression risk.

Implementation notes for Eng:
- Small CSS patch: add .table-row--collapsed { pointer-events: none; } and ensure the interactive children toggle pointer-events:auto when expanded.
- Add design token: token.touchPadding.compact = 8px; used to create ::after hit-area overlay for inline controls.
- Virtualization tweak: when sticky header present && isSafariMobile(), use position: absolute + top rather than transform for the collapsed range. Add telemetry to measure frequency.

QA reproduction steps (minimal):
1) Use a dataset with 200 rows in compact density.
2) Enable virtualization.
3) On iPhone (Safari) and Android (Firefox), toggle density and quickly tap collapsed rows and inline checkboxes in varying scroll momentum scenarios.
4) Observe ghost taps and animation jumps; capture repro video and WebKit/Gecko console logs.

Related artifacts and links:
- Design spec (compact-table-v2): https://confluence.redwood.ai/design/compact-table-v2
- Proposed CSS patch PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui-kit/pull/1428
- Virtualization telemetry dashboard: https://analytics.redwood.ai/dashboards/virtualization-qa
- Customer-reported issue thread: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/customer-support/row-collapse-2026

Notes: This ticket concentrates on cross-browser UX fixes and small token changes. If virtualization core changes are required after telemetry, we will spawn ENG follow-up (ENG-12098).
